scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
I was asked to collect some kind of research charts...
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
我收到委託，要收集一些研究員記錄表...

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
- I hear somebody talking - - remote communication -
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
- 聽到有人在說話 - - 遠端通訊 -

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
[Ohno Tohiro]
My shoulders are heavy.
Our long-cherished wish..
One by one, slowly..
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
[大野 敏弘]
肩膀上的擔子很重。
我們長久以來的願望...
一點一點，慢慢實現...

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Yes... everything is proceeding smoothly.
The status of the report collection is okay.
Yes, sir.
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
是的...一切進展順利。
報告收集的情況良好。
是的，長官。

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
I'll immediately report the information related to the laboratory as a top priority.
Yes, sir...  I'll do so.
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
實驗室相關情報，我會優先立即上報。
是，長官...明白。

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Oh somebody has come! I'll call you again later.
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
哦，有人來了！我稍後再聯絡你。

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Uh...? I didn't realize someone is here already...
hmm... hmm...
Is there something you want from me?
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
呃...？沒注意到這裡已經有人了...
咳...咳...有事找我嗎？

scripts.text: End the conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text: Ask him about the tomb of honor.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於榮譽墓穴的事

scripts.text: Return to the tomb of honor.
scripts.translation: 返回榮譽墓穴

scripts.text: Say that Zeny is not enough.
scripts.translation: 表示Zeny不足

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
There are many adventurers looking for this crevice, except for you!
If you change your mind, come back to me again!
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
除了你之外，有很多冒險者都在尋找這個裂縫！
如果你改變主意了，隨時回來找我！

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
You also heard about the crevice that leads to that place, right?
There are many adventurers like you these days!
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
你也聽說過通往那個地方的裂縫，對吧？
最近像你這樣的冒險者可真多啊！

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
I entered this crevice for the first time and guess what? It led to a place where there are so many monsters swarming around.
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
我第一次進入這個裂縫，你猜怎麼著？裡面竟然擠滿了魔物。

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
I gave a heads up to one adventurer I know. Then, he showed a high interest in it!
He kept muttering to himself about biomedical research, labs something like that.
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
我把這事告訴一個認識的冒險者，他一下就來了興趣！
嘴裡不停唸叨著生體研究、實驗室之類的。

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
He kept asking me to show him how to get there. I felt reluctant to let him know about this crevice because I didn't want others to know about it. But I traded this info for 100,000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
他不斷要求我告訴他怎麼到達那裡。我本來不想讓別人知道這個裂縫，但最終還是以100,000 Zeny的價格賣給了他。

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Not much later, he came back with his body thoroughly injured. It was a miracle that he came back alive... It was horrible...
However, he was holding several items. At first glance, they looked so powerful that even I felt scared.
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
沒過多久，他渾身是傷地回來了。他能活著回來真是個奇蹟...太可怕了...
不過，他手裡拿著幾件物品。乍一看，那些東西強大得連我都感到害怕。

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
After that, many adventurers entered this dangerous place through this crevice after hearing the rumor. I hardly found any adventurers coming out of this crevice again. Since then, this place has been called the tomb of honor.
I earned some money thanks to them, though.
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
之後，許多冒險者聽到傳聞，紛紛通過這條裂縫進入這個危險的地方。我幾乎沒再看到有冒險者從裂縫裡出來。從那以後，這個地方就被稱為榮譽墓穴。
不過，我靠他們賺了不少錢。

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
You want to know why I earned money?
I found this place for the first time, so its ownership belongs to me as well! You got a problem with that?
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
你想知道我為什麼能賺錢嗎？
我是第一個發現這個地方的人，所以所有權也歸我！你有意見嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Hmm hmm... Anyway, give me 100,000 Zeny. Then, I'll open the door which leads to the crevice for adventurers like you...
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
嗯嗯...總之，給我100,000 Zeny。然後，我會為像你這樣的冒險者開啟通往裂縫的門...

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
You don't have enough money!
There is nothing free in this world!
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
你的錢不夠！
這個世界上沒有免費的東西！

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Let me see... one... two... three
Alright. Now that I received the Zeny, I'll open the crevice.
I hope you can come back alive!...
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
讓我看看...一...二...三。
好的。既然收到了Zeny，我就開啟裂縫。
希望你能活著回來！...

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
What? You don't have enough Zeny, but you want to enter?
Hmm... Then... by any chance, you have a research chart?
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
什麼，錢不夠也想進去？
嗯...那個...你手上有沒有研究員記錄表？

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Hush, speak quietly. People around here may hear us. Do you have it or not?
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
噓，小聲點。周圍的人可能會聽到。你到底有沒有？

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Don't ask me why I need it. Just bring me 10 research charts. Then, I'll send you to the tomb of honor for nothing. What you do think?
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
別問我拿來做什麼，帶10張研究員記錄表來，我就免費送你去榮譽墓穴。
怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Go back to the previous menu.
scripts.translation: 返回上一級選單

scripts.text: Hand over 10 research charts.
scripts.translation: 交出10張研究員記錄表

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
You got any other business with me?
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
你還有別的事找我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
It seems 10 research charts are missing now.
Maybe you didn't pick them up from the warehouse.
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
沒湊齊10張研究員記錄表啊，也許是放在倉庫裡忘拿了？

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Is there something else you want from me?
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
還有別的事要我幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Oh... yes, this is it... This is what I need... hoo hoo...
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
哦...對，就是這個...正是我要的...呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
I'll send you to the crevice as promised.
I want you alive. See you again!
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
按約定，我送你去裂縫。
可得活著回來，下次見！

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
What are you looking for? Are you looking for the place where all the dead men roam?
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
你在找什麼？是在找那些亡魂遊蕩的地方嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
I can take you there if you want. You will need ^0000cd20 Sentimental Fragment and 150K Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
想去的話，我可以帶路，需要^0000cd20個邪念碎片和150,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Or you can just see sentiment safely without the interruption of the dead. That will cost you ^0000cd30 Sentimental Fragment and 2M Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
也可以直接去只有思念的地方，安全些，不會被亡魂打擾。
需要^0000cd30個邪念碎片和2,000,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Where do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
你想去哪裡？

scripts.text: Where all the dead men roam.
scripts.translation: 亡魂遊蕩的地方

scripts.text: Only thoughts can be met.
scripts.translation: 只有思念的地方

scripts.text: What kind of place is it?
scripts.translation: 那是什麼樣的地方？

scripts.text: I don't mind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
You have everything right?
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
你帶齊所有東西了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
讓我看看。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
It's not enough. You need ^0000cd20 Sentimental Fragment and 150K Zeny^000000. I can't take you there for free.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
不夠啊，需要^0000cd20個邪念碎片和150,000 Zeny^000000，可不能讓我白帶路。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
You have everything right?
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
你帶齊所有東西了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Good. You have everything. I'll take you there.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
很好。你帶齊了所有東西。我帶你去。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
But... I'm taking you there for money... you should be careful.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
不過...我是為了錢才帶你去的...你要小心。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
So.. if you go inside, you'll see a ^0000cdStrange Machine that looks like a crystal^000000.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
所以...如果你進去，會看到一臺^0000cd看起來像水晶的奇怪機器^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
This machine will recover your HP if you use it. It helped me survive. I have no idea why it's in that kind of place though...
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
使用這臺機器可以恢復你的HP。它曾幫我活了下來。不過我不知道它為什麼會在那種地方...

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
I turned off the machine so no one can use it, but I'll let you use it as my special treat.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
我關掉了機器，不讓別人使用，但我會讓你使用，作為我的特別優待。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Please be careful and use the machine if you need to!!
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
請小心，如果需要的話就使用機器！！

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
You've got all the items and money??
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
你帶齊了所有物品和錢嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
讓我看看。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
It's not enough. ^0000cd30 Sentimental Fragment and 2M Zeny^000000 are needed. I can't take you for free.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
不夠啊，需要^0000cd30個邪念碎片和2,000,000 Zeny^000000，可不能讓我白帶路。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Good. You have everything. I'll take you there.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
很好。你帶齊了所有東西。我帶你去。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
The exit is outside of the wall.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
出口在牆外。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
^EE0000Well, I also have a warning. Your location can't be saved in there, so if you log off or get disconnected, you'll be moved to your save point.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
^EE0000還有件事得提醒你：那裡無法儲存位置，下線或斷線後，就會回到記錄點。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
I dug in the ground to find something to eat and I found something even better.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
我挖地找吃的，結果發現了更好的東西。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
The living can't survive there. Only the dead roam around.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
活人無法在那裡生存。只有死人在那裡徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
There's a rumor.. that people who went there never came back...
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
有個傳聞...說去過那裡的人再也沒有回來...

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
I was so scared but.. it became clear that it's a popular place for adventurers to visit.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
我很害怕，但...後來發現那裡是冒險者常去的地方。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
The place I arrived at was ^0000cdnear Strange Sentiment^000000.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
我到的地方就在^0000cd奇怪的思念附近^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
I ran away since so many dead men tried to kill me.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
因為很多死人試圖殺我，所以我逃跑了。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
But then I got lost and fell down to a weird place.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
然後我迷路了，掉進了一個奇怪的地方。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
The place was the same as where the dead men roam ^0000cdbut there are only sentiments^000000. I was so scared, so I got out right away.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
那裡跟亡魂遊蕩的地方一模一樣，^0000cd卻只有思念^000000。
我很害怕，馬上就逃了出來。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
I will take you there if you give me the money and items.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
如果你給我錢和物品，我就帶你去那裡。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
You might go easier without his help.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
沒有他的幫助，你可能會更容易一些。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Please visit me any time. We have nothing to lose anyway.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
有需要隨時來，反正也沒什麼損失。

scripts.text: Don't exit the dungeon.
scripts.translation: 不離開迷宮

scripts.text: Exit the dungeon.
scripts.translation: 離開迷宮

scripts.text: - You still have business to deal with here -
scripts.translation: - 你在這裡還有事要處理 -

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
Oh! You want to exchange mind or grudge pieces?
scripts.translation:
[資深冒險者]
哦，想兌換意志或怨念碎片？

scripts.text: Listen to the story.
scripts.translation: 聽故事

scripts.text: ^7777771 Will of Warrior (200 Energy pieces)
scripts.translation: ^7777771份戰士意志（200個能量碎片）

scripts.text: ^7777771 Blood Thirst (200 energy pieces)
^7777771 Ghost Chill (300 energy pieces)^000000
^0000001 Ghost Chill (300 energy pieces)^000000
^0000001 Will of Warrior (200 Energy pieces)
scripts.translation: ^0000001份戰士意志（200個能量碎片）

scripts.text: ^0000001 Blood Thirst (200 energy pieces)

[Veteran Adventurer]
You look like you have free time, don't you? Well, my business is slow these days too...
scripts.translation:
[資深冒險者]
你看起來挺閒的，不是嗎？嗯，我最近生意也很冷清...

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
One day, the guild master entered in my guild all of a sudden...
scripts.translation:
[資深冒險者]
有一天，我們會長突然跑到公會裡說...

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
'^1F294DI'll make all members in all guilds wear the Cloak of the Fallen Soldier!!^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[資深冒險者]
“^1F294D我要讓所有公會成員都穿上墮落士兵的斗篷！！^000000”

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
As you know, this equipment requires a large amount of material, so all guild members had no choice but to be stuck in the dungeon and forced to work.
scripts.translation:
[資深冒險者]
你也知道，這件裝備耗費的材料可不少，大家只能被關在地下城里，沒日沒夜地幹活。

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
You never know what luck you eventually may have. I flung myself into this digging work with determination and found so many rare pieces.
scripts.translation:
[資深冒險者]
你永遠不知道最終會有什麼運氣。我懷著堅定的決心投入這項挖掘工作，結果發現了許多稀有碎片。

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
Ms. Sub-guild master sent me to exchange things with others as a pile kept forming.
scripts.translation:
[資深冒險者]
副會長女士派我去和別人交換東西，因為碎片堆積如山。

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
Of course, the amount of exchange was decided by the guild master emphasizing
'^1F294DI'll never accept it if it's below this amount!!^000000'...
scripts.translation:
[資深冒險者]
兌換數量當然也是會長定的，還特意強調：“^1F294D低於這個數，我絕不接受！！^000000”...

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
Ms. Sub-guild master tried to throw dirt into the guild master's eyes. We really had a hard time stopping her.
scripts.translation:
[資深冒險者]
副會長氣得想往會長眼裡撒沙子，好不容易才被我們攔下來。

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
I guess we can take care of it quickly if he adjusts it to a low amount. (sigh)... That's what happened.
scripts.translation:
[資深冒險者]
他要肯把價碼放低點，早就換完了。
唉...事情就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
^3300661 {0}^000000 is exchanged with ^CC3333{1} Energy Pieces^000000.
Exchange.
scripts.translation: 兌換

scripts.text: Do not exchange.
scripts.translation: 不交換

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
What?... I thought you were going to exchange it.
scripts.translation:
[資深冒險者]
什麼？...我以為你要兌換它。

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
Sorry. I don't have a choice because the guild master ordered it. You need {0} items, if he says no, I'm not at liberty to exchange it.
scripts.translation:
[資深冒險者]
抱歉，會長定下的規矩，我也沒辦法。
必須準備{0}個，他不同意，我可不敢擅自給你換。

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
Would you like to continue to exchange it?
scripts.translation:
[資深冒險者]
您想繼續兌換嗎？

scripts.text: Continue with the exchange.
scripts.translation: 繼續兌換

scripts.text: Stop the exchange.
scripts.translation: 停止兌換

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
Thank you... I guess I won't be punished by the guild master, thanks to you.
scripts.translation:
[資深冒險者]
謝謝...多虧了你，我想我不會被公會會長懲罰了。

scripts.text:
[Bully]
Hey, buddy. Do you have some remaining Energy pieces? I'll exchange them with something appropriate if you want.
scripts.translation:
[惡霸]
嘿，夥計。你還有多餘的能量碎片嗎？如果你想的話，我可以拿合適的東西跟你換。

scripts.text: Listen to the story.
scripts.translation: 聽故事

scripts.translation: ^0000001個能量碎片（50個墮落E粒子）

scripts.translation: ^7777771個感傷碎片（50個能量碎片）
